features: Inputs: 8 BNC (AHD/analog) + 4 IP; up to 12 IP channels (up to 12 channels mixed analog + IP)
Analog input: 960H analog cameras and 720p/1080p/5MP AHD cameras; recording up to 5MP Lite (1280x1944)
IP recording bandwidth 16-48 Mbps (16 Mbps default, about +4 Mbps per disabled analog channel)
Coax-channel analytics: PID / LCD / PD / sound detection / camera tampering

Intelligent video analysis on IP channels (depending on IP camera model): perimeter intrusion detection (PID), line crossing detection (LCD), stationary object detection (SOD), pedestrian detection (PD), face detection, cross counting (CC), sound detection, camera tampering
8 alarm inputs, 1 alarm output; 8 audio inputs, 1 audio output (RCA)
1 x BNC spot output (704x576) for analog channels
1 TB HDD included; 1097/578-WH is sold without HDD
Power consumption not recorded: urmet.de states 18.3 W (with HDD), the user manual and urmet.com state 10.9 W (6.4 W without HDD)
Dimensions and weight not recorded: datasheet product data (222 x 300 x 50 mm, 1.689 kg) conflicts with the spec table (300 x 53 x 227 mm, approx. 3 kg)
Named in Urmet S.p.A. NDAA Section 889 statement (main chipset), June 2023
